PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS GENERAL §3.80 Alternate performance requirements. The provisions of §§ 3.84, 3.85, 3.86, and 3.112 (a) (2) (ii) shall not be applicable to airplanes having a maximum certificated take-off weight of 6,000 pounds or less. In lieu thereof, such airplanes shall comply with the provisions of §§ 3.84a, 3.85a, 3.87, and 3.112 (c).
